label: Spiritist
sub-labels: Permanently increase your maximum Mind Points by 5.
You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the Ritualism discipline.

data.label: Healing Power
data.description: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may have each of those allies recover an amount of Hit Points equal to (3 + (SL, multiplied by the number of Bonds you have)). This healing is separate from any healing caused by the effects of the spell.

data.label: Ritual Spiritism
data.description: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the Spiritism discipline. Spiritism Rituals use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

data.label: Spiritual Magic
data.description: Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell (see next two pages). Offensive (🗲) Spiritist spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

data.label: Support Magic
data.description: When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a Bond towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the strength of your Bond towards them.

data.label: Vismagus
data.description: When you cast a spell, if you don’t have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend an amount of Hit Points equal to (10 + the spell’s total MP cost) instead. If a spell cast this way would cause you to recover Hit Points, you instead recover no Hit Points (the spell functions normally on any other target).
